A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the black border (lower left), from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again (490 × 350 pixels), with the picture and a white italic “E” in the black border.

The 2017 slip and the 2018 E card, the card turned a quarter turn to the slip's orientation and scaled to the slip's size; nothing else is edited.
